page_title: Codex Account Switcher for macOS and Windows

summary.name: Codex Account Switcher
summary.one_liner: A free, open-source desktop app for macOS and Windows that lets you switch between multiple Codex Desktop accounts (personal, work, client) with a confirmed, guided handoff.
use_cases: Switching between personal and work Codex accounts
Managing separate client Codex accounts for freelance work
Checking weekly Codex usage per account
Switching Codex Desktop accounts without using Terminal
Keeping account credentials local on your computer
summary.what_it_does: Codex Account Switcher lets you add several authorized Codex accounts by signing in through a browser once per account, then shows them in one menu labeled by identity. You pick an account and confirm; the app closes Codex Desktop, swaps the active credentials, verifies the selected account, and reopens Desktop. It shows the active account and weekly usage, with an optional 5-hour row that appears only if the service provides an exact 300-minute window. Account switches are never automatic or usage-based, and saved account data stays in local user-only folders without a proxy or cloud sync.
notable: Confirmed switching: closes Codex Desktop, switches, verifies, and reopens it; no background rotation
Local-only design with no account proxy, traffic routing, or cloud account service
Signed and Apple-notarized macOS DMG with Sparkle updates; portable Windows EXE
MIT-licensed; shared Swift core with macOS SwiftUI and Windows WPF interfaces
caveats: Windows EXE is currently unsigned and its update checks open the download page
Only supports macOS 14+ on Apple Silicon and Windows 10/11 x64
Existing Codex CLI processes keep their old identity; a new CLI process is needed to use the selected account
Independent project, not affiliated with OpenAI; OpenAI's own switcher currently covers ChatGPT on the web, not Codex desktop
